text:
Maya Patel: Quick reminder — RC cutoff for RC-2026.03 is today at 17:00 PT (about 4h from now). If you think your change needs a late merge, please follow the exception process below.

Lia Chen: Quick q — my SDK dep bump PR touches only build files and no runtime code. Is that allowed into next patch or needs exception?

Maya Patel: If it's purely a dependency pin with no behaviour change, DO NOT merge into release-candidate. Move to next patch. Add a changelog note for the following release instead.

Sanjeev Rao: To be clear: late merges are for customer-impacting bug fixes / critical regressions only. Required for exception: 1) QA ack + passing smoke, 2) Release owner approval, 3) CI green, 4) label `late-merge-exception`.

Jamal Ortiz: Requesting exception for PR #4821 — tokenization edge-case causing parse errors for some customers. Staging smoke ran, initial issue fixed, rerun passed. @Maya Patel please review/approve.

Maya Patel: Can you paste the smoke commands you ran and the minimal repro?

Jamal Ortiz: Sure — commands I ran:
```
./scripts/deploy-staging.sh --tag pr-4821
pytest tests/integration/tokenization_test.py::test_edge_case -q
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" https://staging.redwood.ai/health | jq
```
Repro: payload with unescaped unicode sequence "\u2028" that used to blow up tokenizer. Fixed in parser fallback.

OpsBot: deploy-staging job succeeded (id: 789012). smoke-tests: initial run had 1 failure, rerun passed. :white_check_mark:

ReleaseManager: Exception request logged. I need explicit release-owner sign off to merge. @Maya Patel — please confirm. Once approved, add label `late-merge-exception` and merge to `release-candidate` with the checklist below.

Maya Patel: Approved. Please ensure QA artifacts are attached to the PR and add a one-line changelog note. Merge only after the checklist completes.

ReleaseManager: Checklist to run post-approval:
```
git checkout release-candidate
git pull origin release-candidate
git merge --no-ff pr/4821 -m "cherry-pick: PR #4821 late merge (tokenization fix)"
./scripts/smoke-check.sh || (git reset --hard origin/release-candidate && exit 1)
./scripts/build-tag.sh rc-2026.03 || echo "build failed, revert"
```

Maya Patel: Final reminder: any merges after 17:00 PT without an approved `late-merge-exception` will be reverted from the tagged build and blocked from release. If you need help with cherry-picks, version bumps, or changelog formatting ping @Sanjeev Rao or @Lia Chen.

Sanjeev Rao: Also, update changelog under Unreleased -> 0.12.3 (patch). File: `changelog/0.12.3.md`. One-line summary + PR link is enough.

Lia Chen: Acknowledged — I'll coordinate the changelog and version bump if needed.

OpsBot: release cutoff reminder — 3h 20m remaining :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya Patel: Thanks folks — will post final cutoff call at 30m.
